aboutGame.title: What is Sublustrum?
paragraphs: Sublustrum is a first-person point-and-click adventure game developed by the small independent studio Phantomery Interactive and originally released in 2008. It trades combat, leveling, and objective markers for atmospheric exploration across static, pre-rendered scenes that you rotate, examine, and slowly piece together.

The story is told sideways through architecture, documents, and dreamlike sequences rather than cutscenes. Our Sublustrum Wiki collects walkthroughs, puzzle solutions, story breakdowns, and platform notes so you can stay lost in the atmosphere instead of lost in the interface.

explore.title: Explore Sublustrum Wiki
explore.description: Sublustrum is a slow, atmospheric adventure built on observation and puzzle logic. These modules gather the story background, beginner habits, puzzle families, release details, and media that new players search for first.

modules.description: This module explains the game's narrative background, its isolated setting, and the major story themes. It helps players understand the psychological adventure structure before playing.

highlights.label: Narrative
highlights.detail: The story arrives through places, documents, and dream logic rather than cutscenes or narration.

highlights.label: Isolation

highlights.label: Memory

highlights.label: Ambiguity
highlights.detail: The ending resists a single reading and rewards patient reflection.

modules.name: Sublustrum Beginner Guide
modules.description: A beginner-friendly guide covering basic gameplay concepts, exploration methods, puzzle-solving approach, and important things new players should know. It targets users searching how to start and how the game works.

highlights.detail: Rotate a full 360 degrees in every scene so no hotspot hides behind the default camera.
Look up and down at each view; ceilings, floors, and shelves hold items.
Examine every hotspot, even the dull ones, because some objects only matter later.
Read every readable document fully and note the codes, symbols, and dates inside.
Record symbols, numbers, and colors; the game rarely repeats its clues for you.
Keep multiple save slots and rotate them before attempting anything destructive.

modules.name: Sublustrum Puzzle Guide
modules.description: This section provides solutions and explanations for the game's sound-based puzzles, environmental interactions, and device challenges. It ranks the puzzle families by how often they stall new players.

highlights.label: S
highlights.detail: Environmental observation — hidden switches and light or sound cues stall the most players.

highlights.label: A
highlights.detail: Symbol and cipher — glyph sequences and matching marks demand careful note-taking.

highlights.label: B
highlights.detail: Spatial alignment — rotating rings and mirrored paths test mental rotation.

highlights.label: C
highlights.detail: Mechanical devices — dials, levers, and valves solved by tracing cause and effect.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Sublustrum.

items.question: What is Sublustrum?
items.answer: Sublustrum is a first-person point-and-click adventure game developed by Phantomery Interactive and originally released in 2008. It trades combat and objective markers for atmospheric exploration, documents, and sound-driven puzzles.

items.question: Do I need combat or leveling to progress in Sublustrum?
items.answer: No. Sublustrum has no combat, no leveling, and almost no interface noise. Progress comes from observing scenes, reading documents, and solving environmental and device puzzles.

items.question: How long does it take to finish Sublustrum?
items.answer: Community reports suggest a single evening or a few short sessions, depending on how thoroughly you explore and how long the more abstract Sublustrum puzzles take to solve.

items.question: Can I still play Sublustrum on a modern PC?
items.answer: Yes. Sublustrum targets Windows PC, and most players run it today through digital re-releases, sometimes with compatibility settings for the older builds.

items.question: Does Sublustrum have an official hint system?
items.answer: No. Sublustrum expects you to solve problems through observation and note-taking, which is why our guides focus on puzzle logic and exploration habits rather than straight spoilers.
